Around [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a brutal '''civil war''' occurred on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]]. In the midst of the war,<ref name="Nexus" /> Grizmallt's [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], [[Elsinoré den Tasia]], sponsored an expedition<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> of [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Grizmallti/Legends|Grizmallti]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] aboard<ref name="Nexus" /> three [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ships]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> ''[[Beneficent Tasia]]'', ''[[Constant]]'', and ''[[Mother Vima]]'', to leave Grizmallt<ref name="GB" /> in search of fortune and glory. Led by the [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] [[Kwilaan/Legends|Kwilaan]],<ref name="Secrets">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] eventually reached the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], on which the refugees made [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] and fought a [[Human-Gungan conflicts/Legends|war]] with the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]].<ref name="Nexus" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'' by [[Kristin Lund]] mentioned that Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] had been established by settlers fleeing a revolution on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[832 BBY/Legends|800]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> However, other sources such as the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> and the [[2004]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' established that Naboo was colonized by Humans from Grizmallt around 3900 BBY.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Additionally, [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] stated that Theed became the capital in the aftermath of the [[Time of Suffering/Legends|Time of Suffering]], a civil war on Naboo.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[2016]] sourcebook ''[[Nexus of Power]]'', published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for the ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[roleplaying game]], established that the colonists of Naboo were fleeing a civil war on Grizmallt.<ref name="Nexus" />
